title: ayenia celebica
intro: Ayenia celebica, commonly known as Ayenia, is a plant species native to Central and South America. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Ayenia include antiseptic, antifungal, and antioxidant properties, which make it useful in treating various ailments. Bioactive constituents of Ayenia include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
